name: Spotify
summary: Spotify Web API OAuth. A personal app takes minutes, but Development Mode now needs a Premium owner and allows only 5 allowlisted users. Anything bigger needs extended quota, which Spotify only grants to registered businesses with at least 250k monthly active users.

links.label: Create an app in the dashboard
links.note: opens after Spotify sign-in; same page manages existing apps

links.label: Request extended quota mode
links.note: organizations only, about 250k MAU; request from app Settings > Quota extension Request; review can take up to 6 weeks

verdicts.why: Development Mode works right away for you and up to 5 allowlisted users, as long as the app owner has Spotify Premium.
More than 5 users needs extended quota, which is open only to registered businesses with a launched service and at least 250k monthly active users.

skip.note: Composio has no default OAuth app for Spotify, so you must create your own. Spotify has no official hosted MCP server, and accounts.spotify.com's OAuth metadata has no registration_endpoint.
whyOwnApp: There is no managed option: Composio says to create your own app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

requirements.label: Spotify Premium on the app owner's account
requirements.detail: All Development Mode apps need the owner to keep an active Premium subscription. If it lapses, the app stops working.

requirements.label: An app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard
requirements.detail: Give it a name and description (shown on the consent screen) and accept the Developer Terms.

requirements.label: A valid redirect URI
requirements.detail: Use HTTPS, or plain HTTP only on a loopback IP like 127.0.0.1. The word localhost is not allowed.

requirements.label: Each user added to the allowlist
requirements.detail: Up to 5 Spotify users, each added to the app's allowlist by you.

requirements.label: Registered business with a launched service and 250k+ MAU
requirements.detail: Spotify only accepts extended quota requests from organizations, not individuals, and lists 250k monthly active users as a minimum.

requirements.label: Partner Application and quota extension questionnaire
requirements.detail: Send the Partner Application from a company email, then fill the four-step quota extension request in the dashboard. An agent can draft the answers.

steps.title: Write the OAuth code
steps.detail: Use the authorization code flow if a server holds the secret, or authorization code with PKCE if it cannot. Implicit grant is deprecated.

steps.title: Make sure the owner account has Premium
steps.detail: Development Mode apps do not work without it.

steps.title: Create the app in the dashboard
steps.detail: Click Create an App, enter a name and description, accept the terms, then add redirect URIs under Edit Settings.

steps.title: Allowlist your users
steps.detail: Add yourself and up to 4 more people to the app's allowlist.

steps.title: Handle rate limits and Dev Mode endpoint changes
steps.detail: Back off on 429 using Retry-After, fetch items one by one instead of batch endpoints, and keep search limit at 10 or less.

steps.title: Submit the Partner Application
steps.detail: Send it from a company email address. Only after it is approved can you request extended quota.

steps.title: Request the quota extension
steps.detail: In the dashboard go to Settings, then Quota extension Request, finish the four steps and submit.

steps.title: Spotify reviews the request
steps.detail: Spotify says the review can take up to six weeks.

scopes.name: user-read-playback-state
scopes.meaning: Read the user's current playback and Spotify Connect devices.

scopes.name: user-modify-playback-state
scopes.meaning: Control playback on the user's Spotify clients and devices.

scopes.name: user-library-read
scopes.meaning: Read the user's saved albums, tracks and episodes.

limits.title: 5 users in Development Mode
limits.detail: Each Client ID created since 11 February 2026 allows up to 5 authorized users. Older apps keep users they already had but cannot add past the cap.

limits.title: Owner must keep Premium
limits.detail: If the owner's Premium lapses, the app stops working until they resubscribe.

limits.title: Fewer endpoints in Development Mode
limits.detail: Batch fetches, browse, artist top tracks and other users' profiles and playlists are gone for affected Dev Mode apps, and search returns at most 10 items.

limits.title: Client IDs per developer
limits.detail: The February 2026 rules allowed one Development Mode Client ID per developer. Spotify raised this to 25 in July 2026.

limits.title: Rolling 30 second rate limit
limits.detail: Going over returns 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds. Development Mode has a lower limit than extended quota.

limits.title: No AI training and little commercial use
limits.detail: The Developer Policy bans training or feeding Spotify content into ML or AI models, and limits commercial use. Check this before building an agent on it.

blockers.symptom: The dashboard rejects http://localhost as a redirect URI.
blockers.fix: Use http://127.0.0.1 with your port, or an HTTPS URL.

blockers.symptom: A tester can log in to Spotify but your app will not work for them.
blockers.fix: Add them to the app's allowlist. If you already have 5, remove someone first.

blockers.symptom: The whole app stopped working for everyone.
blockers.fix: Check the owner's Premium subscription. The app resumes once they resubscribe.

blockers.symptom: Calls like GET /tracks or /artists/{id}/top-tracks fail in Development Mode.
blockers.fix: Fetch items one at a time and switch playlist and library calls to the new /items and /me/library endpoints.

blockers.symptom: You are a solo developer and need more than 5 users.
blockers.fix: There is no path: extended quota is for organizations only. Keep it to 5 users or apply through a registered business.

sources.title: Quota modes
sources.note: Up to 5 users in Dev Mode, Premium owner, extended quota for organizations with 250k+ MAU, review up to six weeks, org-only since 15 May 2025.

sources.title: Update on Developer Access and Platform Security (6 Feb 2026)
sources.note: New rules from 11 Feb 2026, applied to existing apps from 9 Mar 2026; endpoint changes postponed for existing apps.

sources.title: February 2026 Dev Mode migration guide
sources.note: Lists removed endpoints; app stops if Premium lapses; Client ID cap raised to 25 as of July 2026.

sources.title: Scopes
sources.note: Spotify has no sensitive or restricted scope tiers, so all are marked basic here.

sources.title: Spotify OAuth authorization server metadata
sources.note: Fetched live: authorize, token and device endpoints, PKCE S256, no registration_endpoint.

unverified: Exactly where in the dashboard users are added to the allowlist and what details are needed; the Apps page does not describe it.
No official Spotify-hosted MCP server was found; only third-party servers turned up in search.
